title: Sealed by God, Rusted by You: The Quran's First and Last Word on the Heart
excerpt: The heart enters the Quran sealed by God (2:7) and exits rusted by what a person earned (83:14) — same frame, reversed hand. The Book's own architecture answers the objection its opening page raises.
seo_title: Why Does Allah Seal Hearts? Quran 2:7 and 83:14
seo_description: The word for heart enters the Quran sealed by God (2:7) and makes its final appearance rusted by what people earned (83:14). A close reading of the Book's own answer.
